project.title: aquascape-wood-v2-views
project.description: Source-matched supplementary artwork for the accepted operator-reviewed V2 individual. Follow the exact master identity and pixel-art drawing.
project.art_direction: Retain the supplied master artwork's naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters and restrained palette. No CGI or photographic noise.
project.session_goal: Source-matched supplementary views/parts for artwork-led 3D construction.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: wood_top
asset.description: View the EXACT same driftwood directly from ABOVE, orthographic top plan. Keep master's left-right orientation, the main long limb runs LEFT to RIGHT and the knotted swollen crotch stays left of center. The whole root's front-back footprint is roughly half its full length. Preserve the locations of main branch junctions and root forks, realistic twisting continuous growth, no new branches. IMPORTANT: exact same individual driftwood and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

plan.prompt:
Subject: The exact same driftwood specimen seen from directly above: one long main limb running left to right, the knotted swollen crotch held left of center, continuous twisting root growth, branch junctions and fork positions unchanged from the master.
Silhouette: Clean readable top-plan outline, front-back footprint about half the full length, every root tip fully visible and uncropped, junction spacing preserved.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Match the master's naturalistic detailed pixel art: deliberate crisp color clusters, restrained earthy palette, coherent painted volume, consistent line weight; no CGI or photographic noise.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Orthographic top-down plan view, looking straight down; keep the master's left-right orientation, no side or three-quarter angle.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Isolated on pure flat white #FFFFFF studio background with generous white margin; no ground plane, no cast shadow, no border or vignette.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No new or invented branches, no extra views or grids, no labels or text, no environment or scenery, no transparency or checkerboard, no cropping of tips.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
